snippet.title: Mecharashi: First Look | When the Epiphyllum Blossoms
snippet.description:
Forget about me, merc. For people like us... the past is better left forgotten.

Mecharashi is a mech-themed tactical turn-based game.
Steel collides, tactics decide, and fate hangs by a thread. / Mech warfare, strategic face-offs, and fate-defining choices.
Every move you make will shape the future of Milkhama.

Visit the Official Mecharashi Website: https://mecharashi.tentree-games.com/
Pre-order Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3446920/Mecharashi/
Pre-order Now on IOS:https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mecharashi/id6670385152
